cut_contour.note: Proposal only (the 25 mm corners of handbook 4.7). The print PDF has no cut line: choose straight or rounded corners at the printer; the background runs into the bleed, so either works.

production.format: 400 x 600 mm (width x height), 3 mm bleed; PDF 406 x 606 mm. Dibond without drill holes, mounted over the existing 40 x 60 column plates with mounting tape
production.material: Sign board (for example dibond or forex) or self adhesive foil for the columns
production.colour: Solid PY-Blauw (no verloop, at Rick's request), white bubble and caption, aqua time window. Print PDF in DeviceCMYK with the token values: PY-Blauw 100/83/0/17 (200 percent ink), PY-Aqua 69/0/21/0, white 0/0/0/0

designs.notes: New design for the walking route to the exit, laid out like the column boards of handbook 4.7 and 4.8 (bubble on top, caption below, caption left aligned to the bubble) at 400 x 600 mm, with a solid PY-Blauw face instead of the verloop (requested): white bubble (py-atom-shape-bubble-solid), navy walking figure and navy route arrow, caption 'Uitgang Voetgangers' and the time window in aqua (as on the door sticker). The figure always walks towards the arrow (mirrored for links). Wayfinding only: it does not replace the green escape route signs (NEN-EN-ISO 7010, NEN 6088).
